name: graphics-session-tools
description: Desktop-neutral X11 session helpers: socket setup, optional NVIDIA/nouveau tuning, and diagnostics.

package:
install -d $DESTDIR/usr/bin
cat > $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-graphics-setup << 'ARYALINUX_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Optional graphics tuning for AryaLinux (all DEs). Safe on non-NVIDIA systems.

set -euo pipefail

MARKER="# aryalinux-graphics-setup"
XORG_SNIPPET="/etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/10-aryalinux-nouveau-safe.conf"
PROFILE_SNIPPET="/etc/profile.d/aryalinux-nouveau-gl.sh"
PLASMA_DROPIN="/etc/plasmalogin.conf.d/aryalinux-session.conf"
SDDM_DROPIN="/etc/sddm.conf.d/aryalinux-session.conf"
SOCKETS_UNIT="early-x11-sockets.service"

need_root() {
    [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || { echo "Run as root." >&2; exit 1; }
}

have_nvidia() {
    command -v lspci >/dev/null 2>&1 && lspci -nn | grep -Eiq 'vga|3d|display.*10de|10de.*vga|10de.*3d'
}

using_nouveau() {
    [ -d /sys/module/nouveau ] && [ ! -d /sys/module/nvidia ]
}

ensure_x11_sockets() {
    if command -v systemd-tmpfiles >/dev/null && [ -f /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/x11.conf ]; then
        systemd-tmpfiles --create /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/x11.conf
    fi
    install -d -m 1777 /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix /tmp/.XIM-unix /tmp/.font-unix
    install_boot_units
}

install_boot_units() {
    cat > /usr/lib/systemd/system/early-x11-sockets.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Ensure X11 socket directories exist
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=display-manager.service
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/mkdir -p /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix /tmp/.XIM-unix /tmp/.font-unix
ExecStart=/bin/chmod 1777 /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix /tmp/.XIM-unix /tmp/.font-unix
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical.target
EOF
    if systemctl is-enabled sddm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        install -d /etc/systemd/system/sddm.service.d
        cat > /etc/systemd/system/sddm.service.d/aryalinux-x11-sockets.conf << 'EOF'
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/bin/mkdir -p /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix /tmp/.XIM-unix /tmp/.font-unix
ExecStartPre=/bin/chmod 1777 /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix /tmp/.XIM-unix /tmp/.font-unix
EOF
    elif systemctl is-enabled plasmalogin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        install -d /etc/systemd/system/plasmalogin.service.d
        cat > /etc/systemd/system/plasmalogin.service.d/aryalinux-x11-sockets.conf << 'EOF'
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/bin/mkdir -p /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix /tmp/.XIM-unix /tmp/.font-unix
ExecStartPre=/bin/chmod 1777 /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix /tmp/.XIM-unix /tmp/.font-unix
EOF
    fi
    systemctl daemon-reload
    systemctl enable early-x11-sockets.service 2>/dev/null || true
}

apply_nouveau_safe() {
    install -d /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d
    rm -f /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/10-nouveau-safe.conf
    cat > "$XORG_SNIPPET" << EOF
# $MARKER — NVIDIA + nouveau only. Remove with: aryalinux-graphics-setup remove
Section "Device"
    Identifier "AryaLinuxNouveau"
    Driver "modesetting"
    Option "AccelMethod" "none"
EndSection

Section "Monitor"
    Identifier "AryaLinuxMonitor0"
    Option "PreferredMode" "1920x1080"
EndSection
EOF
    install -d /etc/profile.d
    cat > "$PROFILE_SNIPPET" << EOF
# $MARKER — prefer classic nouveau DRI over NVK/zink on RTX 20xx/30xx
export MESA_LOADER_DRIVER_OVERRIDE=nouveau
EOF
}

remove_files() {
    rm -f "$XORG_SNIPPET" "$PROFILE_SNIPPET" /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/10-nouveau-safe.conf
    rm -f /etc/plasmalogin.conf.d/aryalinux-nvidia-x11.conf
}

strip_autologin() {
    local f="$1"
    [ -f "$f" ] || return 0
    awk '
        /^\[Autologin\]/ { skip=1; next }
        skip && /^\[/ { skip=0 }
        !skip { print }
    ' "$f" > "${f}.tmp" && mv "${f}.tmp" "$f"
}

restart_display_manager() {
    for dm in plasmalogin sddm lightdm gdm; do
        if systemctl is-active --quiet "$dm" 2>/dev/null; then
            systemctl restart "$dm"
            return
        fi
    done
}

usage() {
    cat <<'EOF'
Usage: aryalinux-graphics-setup <command>

Commands:
  apply     Ensure X11 sockets; apply NVIDIA/nouveau safe settings if detected
  remove    Remove optional AryaLinux graphics snippets (keeps universal X11 sockets)
  status    Show active AryaLinux graphics configuration
  restore-display-manager   Stop manual Xorg and start the enabled display manager
  help      Show this help

Notes:
  - apply/remove are safe on Intel/AMD systems (only universal socket setup runs)
  - KDE session/display-server tweaks: aryalinux-plasma-session (plasma-graphics-tools)
EOF
}

cmd_apply() {
    need_root
    ensure_x11_sockets
    if have_nvidia && using_nouveau; then
        echo "NVIDIA GPU with nouveau detected — applying safe X11/Mesa settings."
        apply_nouveau_safe
    elif have_nvidia; then
        echo "NVIDIA GPU detected (not using nouveau) — only universal X11 setup applied."
        remove_files
    else
        echo "Non-NVIDIA GPU — only universal X11 setup applied."
        remove_files
    fi
    echo "Done."
    if have_nvidia && using_nouveau && systemctl is-enabled sddm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo
        echo "SDDM uses an X11 login greeter by default. Pick "Plasma (X11)" at login,"
        echo "or run: sudo aryalinux-plasma-session x11"
        echo "Then reboot or restart sddm."
    elif have_nvidia && using_nouveau && systemctl is-enabled plasmalogin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo
        echo "NOTE: plasmalogin shows a Wayland-only login greeter. On NVIDIA+nouveau"
        echo "that greeter is often a black screen. Boot straight into Plasma with:"
        echo "  sudo aryalinux-plasma-session autologin YOURUSER plasmax11.desktop"
        echo "Then reboot."
    else
        echo "Reboot or restart your display manager."
    fi
}

cmd_remove() {
    need_root
    remove_files
    strip_autologin "$PLASMA_DROPIN"
    strip_autologin "$SDDM_DROPIN"
    echo "Removed optional AryaLinux graphics snippets."
    echo "Universal X11 socket setup (xorg-server / early-x11-sockets) was kept."
}

cmd_status() {
    echo "=== Universal ==="
    for d in /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix; do
        if [ -d "$d" ]; then
            echo "  present: $d ($(stat -c '%a' "$d"))"
        else
            echo "  missing: $d"
        fi
    done
    if systemctl is-enabled early-x11-sockets.service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "  early-x11-sockets: $(systemctl is-enabled early-x11-sockets.service)"
    fi
    echo "=== Optional NVIDIA/nouveau ==="
    for f in "$XORG_SNIPPET" "$PROFILE_SNIPPET"; do
        [ -f "$f" ] && echo "  present: $f" || echo "  absent:  $f"
    done
    if have_nvidia; then
        echo "  GPU: NVIDIA"
        using_nouveau && echo "  driver: nouveau" || echo "  driver: not nouveau"
    else
        echo "  GPU: not NVIDIA (or lspci unavailable)"
    fi
    echo "=== Display manager ==="
    readlink -f /etc/systemd/system/display-manager.service 2>/dev/null || echo "  (none)"
    [ -f "$SDDM_DROPIN" ] && { echo "  $SDDM_DROPIN:"; cat "$SDDM_DROPIN"; }
    [ -f "$PLASMA_DROPIN" ] && { echo "  $PLASMA_DROPIN:"; cat "$PLASMA_DROPIN"; }
}

cmd_restore_dm() {
    need_root
    ensure_x11_sockets
    pkill -x Xorg 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 1
    for dm in plasmalogin sddm lightdm gdm; do
        if systemctl is-enabled "$dm" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            systemctl start "$dm"
            echo "Started $dm. Switch to the graphical VT (often Ctrl+Alt+F1)."
            return
        fi
    done
    echo "No enabled display manager found." >&2
    exit 1
}

case "${1:-help}" in
    apply) cmd_apply ;;
    remove) cmd_remove ;;
    status) cmd_status ;;
    restore-display-manager) cmd_restore_dm ;;
    help|-h|--help) usage ;;
    *)
        echo "Unknown command: $1" >&2
        usage >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

ARYALINUX_EOF
chmod 755 $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-graphics-setup

install -d $DESTDIR/usr/bin
cat > $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-graphics-diagnose << 'ARYALINUX_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Collect graphics/display diagnostics for AryaLinux (any desktop environment).

set -euo pipefail

REPORT="${1:-/var/log/aryalinux-graphics-diagnose.log}"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$REPORT")"

section() {
    {
        echo
        echo "======== $1 ========"
    } | tee -a "$REPORT"
}

run() {
    {
        echo "\$ $*"
        "$@" 2>&1 || echo "(exit $?)"
    } | tee -a "$REPORT"
}

have() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

: > "$REPORT"

section "System"
run date -Iseconds
run uname -a
run cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || true

section "Boot targets and display manager"
run systemctl get-default 2>/dev/null || true
run readlink -f /etc/systemd/system/display-manager.service 2>/dev/null || true
for svc in plasmalogin sddm lightdm gdm; do
    if have systemctl; then
        run systemctl is-enabled "$svc" 2>/dev/null || true
        run systemctl is-active "$svc" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
done

section "PCI graphics devices"
if have lspci; then
    run lspci -nnk | grep -A3 -Ei 'vga|3d|display'
else
    echo "lspci not installed" | tee -a "$REPORT"
fi

section "Kernel DRM / GPU modules"
run ls -l /dev/dri 2>/dev/null || true
for mod in nouveau nvidia drm_kms_helper drm; do
    if [ -d "/sys/module/$mod" ]; then
        echo "loaded: $mod" | tee -a "$REPORT"
    fi
done
run cat /sys/module/nouveau/parameters/modeset 2>/dev/null || true

section "NVIDIA nouveau firmware (GA10x/GA106)"
for chip in ga106 ga102 gsp; do
    if [ -d "/usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/$chip" ]; then
        echo "present: /usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/$chip" | tee -a "$REPORT"
        run find "/usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/$chip" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -10
    else
        echo "missing: /usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/$chip" | tee -a "$REPORT"
    fi
done

section "Mesa / GL / Vulkan userspace"
for lib in /usr/lib/libGL.so.1 /usr/lib/libEGL.so.1 /usr/lib/libvulkan.so.1; do
    [ -e "$lib" ] && echo "found: $lib" | tee -a "$REPORT" || echo "missing: $lib" | tee -a "$REPORT"
done
if have glxinfo; then
    run glxinfo -B
else
    echo "glxinfo not installed (install mesa demos / mesa-utils if available)" | tee -a "$REPORT"
fi
if have eglinfo; then
    run eglinfo 2>/dev/null | head -40
fi

section "X11 socket directories"
for d in /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix; do
    if [ -d "$d" ]; then
        echo "present: $d ($(stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$d"))" | tee -a "$REPORT"
    else
        echo "missing: $d (X11 sessions need this for all desktop environments)" | tee -a "$REPORT"
    fi
done

section "Plasma / session files"
run ls -l /usr/share/xsessions 2>/dev/null || true
run ls -l /usr/share/wayland-sessions 2>/dev/null || true
run cat /etc/plasmalogin.conf 2>/dev/null || true
for f in /etc/plasmalogin.conf.d/*; do
    [ -f "$f" ] && run cat "$f"
done

section "Recent plasmalogin / greeter logs"
if have journalctl; then
    run journalctl -u plasmalogin -b --no-pager -n 80
    run journalctl -u sddm -b --no-pager -n 40
fi

section "Recent Xorg log"
xlog=""
for f in "$HOME/.local/share/xorg/Xorg.0.log" /var/log/Xorg.0.log; do
    [ -f "$f" ] && xlog="$f" && break
done
if [ -n "$xlog" ]; then
    echo "Using $xlog" | tee -a "$REPORT"
    grep -Ei 'EE|WW|nouveau|nvidia|glamor|modeset|fbdev|glx|dri|GPU' "$xlog" | tail -80 | tee -a "$REPORT" || true
else
    echo "No Xorg.0.log found yet" | tee -a "$REPORT"
fi

section "Recommendations"
{
    echo
    if lspci -nn 2>/dev/null | grep -Eiq 'nvidia'; then
        echo "- NVIDIA GPU detected."
        if [ ! -d /usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/ga106 ] && [ ! -d /usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/ga102 ]; then
            echo "  Install nouveau firmware: alps install nouveau-firmware"
        fi
        if [ ! -d /sys/module/nouveau ] && [ ! -d /sys/module/nvidia ]; then
            echo "  No nouveau/nvidia kernel module loaded. Check kernel config and blacklist rules."
        fi
        if [ ! -f /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/10-aryalinux-nouveau-safe.conf ]; then
            echo "  NVIDIA+nouveau: sudo aryalinux-graphics-setup apply"
        fi
        if ! grep -q '^\[Autologin\]' /etc/plasmalogin.conf.d/aryalinux-session.conf 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "  plasmalogin black greeter on NVIDIA+nouveau: sudo aryalinux-plasma-session autologin USER plasmax11.desktop"
        fi
    fi
    if [ ! -e /dev/dri/card0 ]; then
        echo "- /dev/dri/card0 missing: DRM/kernel driver problem."
    fi
    if [ ! -d /tmp/.X11-unix ]; then
        echo "- /tmp/.X11-unix missing: run 'sudo aryalinux-graphics-setup apply' or reinstall xorg-server."
    fi
    if [ -f "$HOME/.local/share/xorg/Xorg.0.log" ] && grep -q 'directory /tmp/.X11-unix will not be created' "$HOME/.local/share/xorg/Xorg.0.log" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "- Xorg could not create /tmp/.X11-unix; desktop clients will not connect (black screen + cursor)."
    fi
    echo
    echo "Full report saved to: $REPORT"
} | tee -a "$REPORT"

ARYALINUX_EOF
chmod 755 $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-graphics-diagnose

install -d $DESTDIR/usr/share/doc/graphics-session-tools-1.0
cat > $DESTDIR/usr/share/doc/graphics-session-tools-1.0/README.md << 'ARYALINUX_EOF'
# Graphics session tools

Desktop-environment-neutral helpers for X11 display sessions on AryaLinux.

Works with KDE (plasmalogin), SDDM, LightDM, GDM, or manual `Xorg` starts.

## aryalinux-graphics-setup

```bash
sudo aryalinux-graphics-setup apply      # everyone: X11 sockets; NVIDIA+nouveau: safe X11/Mesa
sudo aryalinux-graphics-setup status
sudo aryalinux-graphics-setup remove     # drop optional snippets; keep universal socket setup
sudo aryalinux-graphics-setup restore-display-manager
```

On Intel/AMD systems, `apply` only ensures `/tmp/.X11-unix` exists and enables
`early-x11-sockets.service` from `xorg-server`.

On NVIDIA systems using **nouveau**, it also installs optional safe Xorg/Mesa
snippets. It does nothing when the proprietary `nvidia` module is loaded.

**SDDM note:** meta.kde uses SDDM (X11 greeter, Debian/Kubuntu model). The Plasma login *greeter* is Wayland-only. On NVIDIA+nouveau
it often stays black. Use `aryalinux-plasma-session autologin` to boot into Plasma
on X11, or install another display manager (e.g. LightDM) for a classic login screen.

## aryalinux-graphics-diagnose

```bash
sudo aryalinux-graphics-diagnose
```

## KDE-specific session tweaks

Install `plasma-graphics-tools` for `aryalinux-plasma-session` (X11/Wayland
plasmalogin drop-in only).

## Related ports

- `xorg-server` — universal `/tmp/.X11-unix` setup at install time
- `nouveau-firmware` — optional, NVIDIA RTX 20xx/30xx with nouveau
- `plasma-graphics-tools` — KDE plasmalogin session helper
ARYALINUX_EOF
chmod 644 $DESTDIR/usr/share/doc/graphics-session-tools-1.0/README.md
